## 1. Goal

Small quality improvements that make the demo smoother: system dark mode, Space/right-arrow shortcuts, no sideways scrolling on a laptop screen.

## 2. Background

**PRD §1A rule:** nothing from "Nice to have" starts until every "Must have" row is done and the full demo path has run once end to end (K-32).

**From PRD §1A N7:**

| # | Feature | Owner | Why it is worth it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| N7 | Dark mode, keyboard shortcuts, mobile layout polish | Krishna | Polish |

**From BLUEPRINT §5 Quality details:**

- Keyboard: Space plays or pauses, the right arrow steps one event.
- Works in light and dark mode, and on a laptop screen without scrolling sideways.
- Results export as CSV, so a case found on the website can be re-run in Python.

## 3. Scope

**In scope:**

- Dark theme via `prefers-color-scheme`
- Space = play/pause, right arrow = step
- Layout fixes for laptop widths

**Out of scope:**

- New features

## 4. Files

| Path | Create / modify | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `web/css/style.css` | modify | Themes, layout |
| `web/js/app.js` | modify | Shortcuts |

## 5. Specification

Shortcuts ignored while typing in an input. Colours remain CSS variables.

## 6. Step-by-step tasks

1. Dark variables
2. Shortcuts
3. Layout check at laptop widths

## 7. Tests to write

| Test name | What it checks | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dark-mode` | System dark | Readable, all states |
| `shortcuts` | Space and → outside inputs | Play/pause and step |
| `no-hscroll` | 1280-px wide window | No horizontal scroll |

## 8. Acceptance criteria (Done when)

- [ ] Dark mode follows the system
- [ ] Space plays/pauses, right arrow steps
- [ ] No sideways scroll on a laptop screen

## 9. How to verify

Check each item by hand from `file://` and record in the PR.

## 10. Viva notes

**Idea:** small touches that keep the live demo calm.
**Examiner question:** "Can I step with the keyboard?" — Yes, the right arrow steps one event.

## 11. Pitfalls

- Shortcuts firing inside text inputs
